password.title: Mi Fitness — Xiaomi Login
password.description:
Enter your Xiaomi account credentials. If 2FA is enabled, a verification code will be sent to you by SMS or email.

The password is not stored unless you tick “Remember password”: a long-lived session token is used instead. Without it, an expired token means entering the password again.

data.save_password: Remember password (only needed if the session token expires)

tokens.title: Mi Fitness — Manual Token Entry
tokens.description:
Advanced: enter account credentials obtained from your own Mi Fitness session.

• ssecurity, userId, cUserId — from the serviceLoginAuth2 response
• passToken — from the serviceLoginAuth2 Set-Cookie header
• serviceToken — from the STS Set-Cookie header

passToken lets the integration refresh tokens without 2FA. Highly recommended.
